caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented object resembling a rough, elongated rectangle or slab, placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The main object is colored in shades of brown, with slight variations that include touches of reddish-brown, gray, and hints of dark and light patches suggesting irregular surface texture. There is a small area of darker lines and a faint mark in pinkish-red toward the lower right side of the object. The overall form lacks distinct features or ornamentation and appears organically shaped, with uneven edges and subtle shading to indicate depth. No additional objects or background elements are present. The paper has some visible discoloration and minor marks, particularly near the edges, giving it an aged appearance.
